description: Appends a single TODO item to the project's TODO surface. The only sanctioned write path for TODOs — agents do not edit .github/todo/ files directly. The todo-manager owns deduplication, ageing, and archival downstream.
checklist: 1. Validate the payload contains: title (<= 80 chars), body (optional markdown), source_agent, source_scope_path, severity (info|minor|major|blocker), tags[] (free-form labels), related_paths[] (files that triggered the TODO)
2. Compute the target file: .github/todo/<scope-slug>.md where scope-slug is the kebab-cased scope_path (root → 'project'); create the file with a header if it does not exist
3. Check for an existing entry whose title matches case-insensitively in the same file; if found, append a 'seen-again on <ISO date>' bump line under that entry instead of creating a duplicate
4. Otherwise append a new entry with: '- [ ] <title>  \n  _added <ISO date> by <source_agent> · severity: <severity> · scope: <source_scope_path>_  \n  <body if present>'
5. Never check off (- [x]) an item — only the agent that completed the underlying work may do that, via update-context
6. Call log-action to record the append (target file, title, source agent)
7. Return { todo_file, line_anchor } to the caller
